1. The above unaudited financial results of the company for the quarter & half year ended September 30th, 2026 have been reviewed by the Audit Committee and approved by the Board of Directors at their respective meetings held on 14h November, 2026 . The same have been subjected to limited review by the Statutory Auditors.

2. These financial results have been prepared in accordance with the recognition and measurement principles of applicable Indian Accounting Standards ('Ind AS') prescribed under section 133 of the Companies Act, 2013 read with relevant rules issued there under.

3. The Company's operations fall within a single business segment "Fertilisers and Other Trading Materials". Hence, no separate segment information is disclosed.

4. The Company has long term credit rating CRISIL A+ by CRISIL & ICRA A+ by ICRA.

5.The Company does not have any subsidiary/associate/joint venture company(ies), as on 30th September 2026 hence, consolidated financial statement is not applicable on the Company.

6.Results are available on the websites of the Stock Exchange www.nseindia.com and Company's website www.mbapl.com

7. The Board of Directors of the Company at their meeting held on 26th May 2026, have approved the sub-division/ split of equity shares of face value of Rs. 10/- (Rupees Ten only) each, fully paid-up, into 5 (five) equity shares having face value of Rs 2/- (Rupees two only) each, fully paid-up. On 24th June 2026, the shareholders of the company has approved the proposal for sub division with the requisite majority at Annual General Meeting. The record date for the said sub-division/ split was 3rd July, 2026. Accordingly, the impact of stock split was considered in the computation of basic and diluted Earning per share (EPS) for the quarter & half year ended September 30, 2026 and comparative figures till prior period have also been adjusted to give effect to such sub-division/split in accordance with requirements under lnd AS 33 - Earnings per share.

8. During the quarter, the Company allotted 2,07,23,000 equity shares of face value Rs.2 each at an issue price of Rs.145 per share (including a securities premium of Rs.143 per share) on a preferential basis to non promotor on 10 September 2026, aggregating to Rs.30,048.35 lakh.Consequent to the aforesaid allotment, the issued, subscribed and paid-up equity share capital of the Company increased to 45,88,57,700 equity shares of face value Rs.2 each, aggregating to Rs.9,177.15 lakh.
Basic Earnings Per Share (EPS) and Diluted Earnings Per Share (EPS) for the period have been calculated in accordance with Ind AS 33, Earnings Per Share, considering the weighted average number of equity shares outstanding during the respective reporting periods, including the effect of the aforesaid allotment from the date of allotment, wherever applicable.

9. Previous period figures have been regrouped/reclassified, wherever necessary, to confirm with the current period classification/presentation.
